item.title: Pikachu Spent 67 Days In Space As Part Of Pokémon X ESA Collaboration

description.p: Pika! (Translation: "So connected to love").The Pokémon Company and European Space Agency (ESA) have announced a new collaboration to celebrate World Space Week (4th -10th October).As part of the collab, a special Pikachu plush was sent up to the International Space Station for a total of 67 days, from 11th April to 27th June 2026, completing 1040 orbits. We've yet to receive our own comment from Pikachu, but word on the street is it said something along the lines of being "connected to life" and "connect to love", so yeah, you do you, Pikachu.Read the full article on nintendolife.com

item.title: "Some Compromises Are Inevitable" - 007 First Light Dev Talks Switch 2 Delay, Performance & More

description.p: "We're definitely getting close to the final phase".Just last week, we received the perhaps unsurprising news that 007 First Light was going to be delayed on Switch 2. Again. That 'Summer 2026' window has been pushed to March 2027, and in light of the new release date, developer IO Interactive has spoken about its reasoning for the rescheduling.In a new interview with Inven Global, IO technical producer Cristina Vega clarifies that "While being delayed for a third time is certainly disappointing news for fans, this decision was also made for their benefit". While this delay stemmed from the team needing "a brief breather" after an extended period of pushing the development, "combined with requests from marketing and various other factors" and implementing a new 'Meshnets' rendering system, Vega is reassuringly optimistic about the Switch 2 port as a whole:Read the full article on nintendolife.com
